# OptimAI

> OptimAI builds practical AI and automation systems for SMEs, startups and everyday business owners in Australia. No jargon, no lock-in contracts, and most projects are live in weeks, not months.

OptimAI helps real businesses hand off everyday work such as chasing invoices, email campaigns, social posting, booking reminders, customer databases, reports, client onboarding and after-hours customer questions. We work in three steps: you tell us how you work and we send a free AI and Automation Time-Saving Report; we build it and connect it to the tools you already use; then your team is trained to run it and we stay on call.

## Start here

- [Free AI and Automation Time-Saving Report](https://optimai.com.au/free-report): a free report showing where AI and automation can save your business time and what it could be worth
- [What we actually do](https://optimai.com.au/what-we-actually-do): the step-by-step journey from where you are now to an automated, AI-powered business
- [Services](https://optimai.com.au/services): strategic advisory, marketing automation, business process automation, AI integration, managed services and getting found in AI search
- [Pricing](https://optimai.com.au/pricing): build an instant estimate for your project
- [Ready-to-go products](https://optimai.com.au/products): fixed-price AI and automation setups
